title_or_table: Annual Survey of State Government Tax Collections, fiscal year 2025, flat file (all tax items); population from Vintage 2025 state population estimates (NST-EST2025-ALLDATA)
table_id: STC FY2025 flat file, items T01 to T99 summed (equals API aggregate STC001); NST-EST2025-ALLDATA, POPESTIMATE2024
observation_period: State fiscal year 2025 (for 46 states, July 2024 to June 2025); population on July 1, 2024
geography: 50 states, with a United States row (code US); DC is not a state government in this survey
universe_or_base: Taxes collected by state governments (not local governments): sales, income, property, license and other taxes
unit: total_taxes_thousands in thousands of dollars; taxes_per_resident in dollars, computed by the studio as total taxes over the July 1, 2024 population
vintage: STC fiscal 2025 release; Vintage 2025 population estimates
qualification: State government collections only; states split taxing differently between state and local governments, and some collect taxes paid largely by nonresidents (severance taxes, tourism), so per-resident figures compare state tax systems, not the tax each resident pays

code.description: USPS state code, US for the nation

printed_source_line: Source: U.S. Census Bureau, Annual Survey of State Government Tax Collections, fiscal 2025, and Vintage 2025 population estimates, 50 states. Retrieved November 11, 2026. State government taxes only; some are paid largely by nonresidents; per-resident figures computed by Oath & Action.
notes: The flat file marks items a state does not levy with X; they count as zero in the total
Each state's summed total matches the data API's aggregate STC001 for 2025
